subject: Procurely: invoice origin, delivery preference & digital acknowledgement
messages:
From: Samantha Pierce <samantha.pierce@procurely.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Procurely: invoice creation & delivery preference (digital acknowledgement needed)

Hi Neha,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call earlier. As we start vendor setup on our side I need to confirm how Redwood will emit invoices and what evidence you can provide for EU VAT handling. A few items from Procurely AP: 

- Who will be the invoice originator email (billing sender) and sender address?
- Will you push e-invoices to our portal (preferred) or do you only send PDFs by email? If you can do both, we need to know the primary channel and whether emailed PDFs can be sent as copies.
- For EU VAT: we require the VAT registration number on invoices and a signed digital acknowledgement for the invoice origin (this is a Procurely control).
- PO/Reference handling: are there configurable invoice fields we can map to our PO number?

I've attached our Procurely AP template to show the fields we capture (Procurely-AP-Template.xlsx). Our processing team would like a pilot: portal push + email copy for the first 2 invoices to validate matching.

AP contact for the vendor record is ap-team@procurely.com.

Can you confirm? If you need any vendor forms from us, let me know.

Thanks,
Samantha Pierce
Head of AP Operations
Procurely Inc

Attachment: Procurely-AP-Template.xlsx

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Pierce <samantha.pierce@procurely.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-22T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Procurely: invoice creation & delivery preference (digital acknowledgement needed)

Hi Samantha —

Appreciate the clear list. Short answers up front, details below:

- Invoice originator: Redwood will emit invoices from billing@redwood.ai (we can include a sender name like "Redwood Inference Billing").
- Delivery: Our standard is portal push (EINV) as the canonical delivery. We support a simultaneous email copy (PDF) to an address you specify.
- VAT: We include VAT numbers on EU invoices. For your signed acknowledgement we can route a DocuSign packet (or accept a signed PDF).
- PO mapping: yes — we can populate a PO/reference field and include it in the PDF and the EINV payload.

Proposal for onboarding to minimize friction:
1) Portal push = primary channel.
2) For vendor setup phase, we will send an email PDF copy to ap-team@procurely.com for the first three invoices as a validation window.
3) We will include Procurely's VAT ID on all EU invoices once provided.
4) We will send a DocuSign link for the acknowledgement you mentioned.

I've attached an internal sample invoice so your AP team can verify the field layout (Redwood-invoice-sample.pdf). Connor, can you log this as a billing onboarding task and track the DocuSign acknowledgement?

Samantha, if that plan works, confirm and we'll schedule the first invoice emission after you confirm VAT number and whether you require PO in the invoice header or line-level.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood-invoice-sample.pdf

From: Samantha Pierce <samantha.pierce@procurely.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, AP Team <ap-team@procurely.com>
Date: 2028-07-25T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Procurely: invoice creation & delivery preference (digital acknowledgement needed)

Neha — thanks, that sounds good. A couple clarifications from our side: 

- Confirmed AP inbox: ap-team@procurely.com (please copy this for the pilot invoices).
- VAT number: PL-998877665 (we will provide the formal VAT certificate by reply attachment).
- PO handling: We prefer PO in the invoice header mapped to our field "Procurely PO#" — header-level is sufficient for our ERP matching.
- DocuSign: We can sign the acknowledgement electronically; please send the link.

We'll attach the VAT certificate in our next reply. Pilot plan approved for first three invoices. Please advise expected timing for the first emission so our AP team can watch for it.

Best,
Samantha

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Pierce <samantha.pierce@procurely.com>, AP Team <ap-team@procurely.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-28T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Confirmation: invoice origin, pilot window & DocuSign link

Hi Samantha / Procurely AP —

Thanks for confirming. Finalizing the setup from Redwood's side: 

- Invoice originator: billing@redwood.ai ("Redwood Inference Billing"). The portal EINV payload will include the VAT ID field and a "Procurely PO#" header field.
- Pilot window: Portal push is primary; Redwood will send email PDF copies (to ap-team@procurely.com) for the first three invoices. After the pilot we will switch to portal-only unless you request otherwise.
- Timing: we expect the first invoice to emit on 2028-08-05 (billing cycle close 2028-07-31). We will notify you 24 hours before emission.
- DocuSign acknowledgement: please sign here — https://app.docusign.com/packets/8a7b2c2f-acknowledge-invoice-route

Next steps for Procurely:
- Reply with the VAT certificate (if you haven't already attached it).
- Confirm the exact PO header label ("Procurely PO#" OK?) and any remittance instructions we should include on the invoice PDF.

I've created an onboarding task and attached a short acceptance stub for your records (procurely-ap-ack.txt). Connor will track the task and follow up on the DocuSign completion.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Sr. Billing Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: procurely-ap-ack.txt
